extracted.name: Quick and Easy Buffalo Chicken Dip
extracted.description: Whether it's game day or every day, you'll want to dip everything in this super quick, 4-ingredient Buffalo chicken dip featuring Tyson® Pulled Chicken Breast.
ingredient_lines: 1 (20 ounce) bag Tyson Grilled & Ready® Pulled Chicken Breast, thawed
instruction_lines: Combine cream cheese, sour cream, and Buffalo sauce in a mixing or microwave-safe bowl.
Fold in pulled chicken once thawed, and serve cold or microwave on high for 2 minutes, stirring until the dip is heated throughout.
Serve alongside your favorite tortilla chips.
